evals.name: perf-complaint-invokes-diagnose
evals.prompt: Our search endpoint got really slow this week and I don't know why.
evals.expected_output: do-diagnose is invoked and performs root-cause analysis

assertions.text: Forms and tests hypotheses rather than guessing a fix

evals.name: root-cause-before-fix
evals.prompt: /do-diagnose --focus performance The report page takes 12 seconds to render
evals.expected_output: A root cause is established with evidence before any remediation is proposed

assertions.text: A specific root-cause mechanism is stated, not just a symptom
Evidence for the root cause is cited (measurement, code path, or trace)
Does not disable or skip a test to make anything pass
